scope: 1995 two-phase historical exterior interpretation, not current/as-built condition or exact construction reconstruction
private_source_review_policy: Detailed original-pixel review remains private; no source scan or crop is embedded here.

per_image_review.observed: Complete southwest overview: stepped auditorium, lower west wings, U-shaped seven-storey volume and distinct upper-window rhythm visible.
Complete northeast overview: east five-storey wing, narrow eastern fins/glazing, courtyard and unequal wing heights visible.
Complete north elevation: lower wings and main 1–5F broad window assemblies versus 6–7F narrow windows remain distinct.
Complete south elevation including southeast paired AW10 and short AW10-prime revision louvers; extra whitespace does not clip building.
Complete west elevation: curved auditorium, side slit windows and arch entry readable. Lower front-skin ambiguity remains expressly documented, not certified as a perfect elevation match.
Complete east elevation: clock, central glass strip, two groups of tall fins and paired narrow windows differ from west facade.
Complete roof plan: three opaque mono-pitch strips, stepped/curved auditorium, two west lightwells, east triangular glass end and relocated clock visible; no false roof-interface gap.
Intentional local entry view: curved-side windows are no longer buried, A4-13 arch outline and projecting entry platform readable; ornamental profiles remain simplified.
Intentional local east roof view: glass ridge continues to triangular tip, clock relocation appears consistently applied to body/pyramid/dial; no unintended hip-down tip.
Intentional local courtyard view: curved west foyer has vertical glazing grid and one backed arch at either end; internal east-atria stairs are not falsely pasted on this skin.

visual_method: All ten individual final PNGs directly inspected, not inferred from a montage. Seven whole-building views retain frame margins; three named detail views intentionally crop surrounding architecture. render-v5 log confirmed Blender quit.
